sermon.title: Falling For Lies — August 11, 2024
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: People are turning from truth to fables. Parks, schools and colleges teach evolution as fact, but DNA is a code far beyond any software and cannot arise by accident. God’s power is clearly seen in creation, like Paul’s challenge to Ephesus’s Artemis. Seek Him with all your heart.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Contains played video clips (Exploration Films cell-biology footage; a creation-scientist interview; mention of Ken Ham / Answers in Genesis). Young-earth and worldwide-flood claims are made by the interviewed guest in a clip. The message comes first; the worship set follows (~49:13).
